name: application-dietary-filter-chips
title: Dietary Filter Chips
description: Multi-select dietary-preference chips with an icon and label per option, toggled independently via real aria-pressed state.
useWhen: Filtering a menu or food listing by dietary preference (vegan, gluten-free, spicy, nut-free) with multiple filters active at once.
Each preference benefits from a small icon alongside its label for quick visual scanning.
You want visually distinct selected colors for different preference categories (e.g. allergen warnings in amber vs. lifestyle choices in green).
avoidWhen: You're filtering by generic tags/labels unrelated to diet — use `tag-filter-group` for that general-purpose case instead.
Only one dietary filter can apply at a time — a single-select control communicates that constraint better than independent chips.
This needs to double as an allergen disclosure/warning system — consult food-safety requirements before relying on chip color alone for critical allergen information; always pair with explicit text.
responsiveBehavior: Chips wrap onto additional lines via flex-wrap as the container narrows or more options are added.
accessibility: The chip row has role="group" with an aria-label describing it as a dietary preference filter.
Each chip is a real toggle button with aria-pressed reflecting its selected state, not a link or hidden checkbox behind a label.
Selected chips are distinguished by both fill color and label text, never color alone, so meaning survives without color perception.
Icons are decorative; the dietary term is always present as visible text, never conveyed by icon alone.

variants.title: Dietary Filter Chips
variants.description: Five dietary chips (Vegan and Gluten-free selected in emerald/amber, Vegetarian/Spicy/Nut-free available).
accessibility: Each chip's selection is independent real state, so any combination of dietary filters can be active at once.

variants.title: Dietary Filter Chips (Dark)
variants.description: Dietary filter chips adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Selected and unselected chip colors are tuned to meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark surface.
